title: LTL Formulas
description: Expresses properties over linear time - 'always', 'eventually', 'until' - in Linear Temporal Logic. LTL turns 'the system should never deadlock' into checkable mathematics.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: CTL Branching
description: Reasons about branching time - 'on all paths', 'on some path' - with Computation Tree Logic. CTL suits systems where choices branch, like game trees and protocols with options.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Kripke Structures
description: Models systems as Kripke structures - states, transitions, labels - the common language of model checkers. Everything checkable becomes states and steps.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: State-Space Exploration
description: Explores reachable states exhaustively - BFS, DFS, symbolic - hunting for property violations. Exploration is proof by exhaustion: if no violation is found in all states, the property holds.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Counterexample Traces
description: Produces minimal traces showing exactly how a property is violated - the steps to the bug. Counterexamples turn 'property failed' into a reproducible debugging story.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Fairness Constraints
description: Rules out unrealistic infinite behaviors - like a scheduler starving a process forever - with fairness assumptions. Fairness keeps verification focused on behaviors that can actually happen.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Bounded Model Checking
description: Searches for violations up to a bound k, unrolling loops k times into SAT. BMC finds shallow bugs fast in systems too big for unbounded proof.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Symbolic Execution
description: Executes with symbolic inputs, exploring paths as constraints solved by SMT. Symbolic execution covers input spaces no test suite could enumerate.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Abstraction Refinement
description: Starts with a coarse abstraction and refines only where spurious counterexamples appear - CEGAR. Refinement focuses precision where the property needs it.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Property Patterns
description: Catalogs reusable property patterns - response, precedence, bounded existence - so spec authors start from proven templates. Patterns make temporal specs accessible to non-logicians.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Liveness versus Safety
description: Distinguishes safety ('nothing bad happens') from liveness ('something good eventually happens') - different properties need different proof techniques. The distinction organizes all temporal reasoning.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Deadlock Detection
description: Detects states where no progress is possible - circular waits, exhausted resources - across the whole state space. Detection finds the deadlocks testing never triggers.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Invariant Checking
description: Verifies state invariants - 'balance never negative' - hold in every reachable state. Invariants are the workhorse property: simple to state, powerful to prove.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Temporal Test Oracles
description: Turns temporal properties into runtime monitors - test oracles that watch executions and flag violations. Oracles bring verification to testing: every run checks the property.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Compositional Reasoning
description: Verifies components separately against contracts, then composes the guarantees - assume-guarantee reasoning. Composition scales verification to systems no monolithic check could handle.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.
